name: Tsujimoto Kakomi
source:
The founder of the "Creative Society" and its president. She cannot go against Seigi and his friends. 
The reason she opened the society in the first place is in order to make her own doujinshi. She likes to fantasize about yaoi and boy's love.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%83%AB%E3%83%BC%E3%83%B3%E3%83%AD%E3%82%AA%E3%83%89#.E4.BB.AE.E6.83.B3.E7.A0.94]the Japanese Wikipedia[/url].]
